decisions.reason: It has remained on the market after the first screening period and, as a complementary coolant-system product for an established machinery firm, it is worth keeping while market uptake continues to clarify at low portfolio risk.

Although a coolant cleaning centrifuge is somewhat more specialized and may need longer to prove demand, its survival into 2024 suggests enough option value to justify keeping it open rather than abandoning it now.

The scraper belt chip conveyor fits closely with the firm’s core industrial equipment offering, and since weaker launches were already removed, this remaining product likely still has favorable enough prospects to retain.
The hinged belt chip conveyor appears to be a core-adjacent variant with continuing strategic fit, so a large incumbent would likely keep it on the market while uncertainty resolves further.
